answer_1.quote: We apply CEPED to LLAMA-2-CHAT and show that while preserving their instruction understanding ability, CEPED-LLAMA-2-CHAT can incorporate more context and improve performance on long-text understanding tasks.

answer_2.quote: For NarrativeQA (NQA) and Qspr (QASPER), we report the F1 scores. For QALT (QuALITY), we report accuracy. For GovReport (GvRp), SummScreenFD (SSFD), and QMSum, we report the ROUGE-L scores.
